name: RoboSet
summary: 真实家庭桌面操作数据集，覆盖厨房等日常活动中的多技能、多任务演示，包含四视角图像、语言定义任务、遥操作和动觉回放轨迹。
summaryEn: A real household tabletop manipulation dataset with multi-skill, multi-task demonstrations across everyday activities, four camera views, language-defined tasks, teleoperation, and kinesthetic playback trajectories.
scale: 100,050 released trajectories overall; RoboAgent MT-ACT subset uses 7,500 trajectories across 12 skills and 38 tasks
scaleZh: 整体发布 100,050 条轨迹；RoboAgent MT-ACT 子集包含 12 类技能、38 项任务的 7,500 条轨迹
organizations: Carnegie Mellon University, Meta AI, and collaborators
organizationsZh: 卡内基梅隆大学、Meta AI 及合作者
license: MIT License for RoboAgent code and RoboSet datasets
licenseZh: RoboAgent 代码和 RoboSet 数据集采用 MIT License
access: Official RoboSet pages provide downloadable trajectories; alternate Hugging Face mirror is referenced by the code repository
accessZh: 官方 RoboSet 页面提供可下载轨迹；代码仓库引用了备用 Hugging Face 镜像
verdict: 真实多技能桌面操作轨迹
wmNote: 多视角、语言任务和动作轨迹使其适合训练可泛化的操作世界模型；不同子集规模和来源需要在实验中明确说明。
wmNoteEn: Multiview observations, language tasks, and action trajectories support generalizable manipulation world models; experiments should state which subset and collection source are used.
